# DevSec - MLSecOps Security Pipeline Tool

> MLSecOps security pipeline tool for automated scanning, policy enforcement, compliance mapping, and ML validation in CI/CD pipelines.

## Overview

DevSec is a comprehensive security tool that integrates multiple security scanners, provides OPA-based policy evaluation, and maps findings to compliance frameworks like SOC 2, ISO 27001, and GDPR.

## Key Features

- Security Scanning: Gitleaks (secrets), Semgrep (SAST), Trivy (vulnerabilities), OSV (dependencies)
- Policy Engine: OPA/Rego-based policy evaluation with custom rules
- Compliance Mapping: SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR framework mapping
- ML Validation: Framework detection, model cards, data drift, fairness analysis
- Supply Chain: SBOM generation (SPDX, CycloneDX), artifact signing, SLSA provenance
- Pipeline Orchestration: YAML-based pipeline execution with parallel stages

## Installation

```bash
curl -sSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/victoralfred/devsec/main/install.sh | bash
```

## Quick Start

```bash
# Scan for secrets
devsec scan secrets .

# Scan for vulnerabilities
devsec scan vulnerabilities .

# Run compliance assessment
devsec compliance assess . --frameworks soc2,iso27001

# Run full pipeline
devsec pipeline run
```
